items.title: What Matters More to Putin? Russian Refineries or Striking Ukraine?
items.description: Kyiv Post Senior Defense Correspondent Stefan Korshak joins TVP World to discuss whether an energy ceasefire could pave the way for broader negotiations, how Ukrainian strikes are affecting Russia’s war economy, and why the Kremlin continues to favor military pressure over compromise.

items.title: Iran war live: Tehran open to ‘real diplomacy’, ready for ‘apocalyptic war’
items.description: Abbas Araghchi's warning comes after Washington rejected a seven-day roadmap to end the war and reopen Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Ethiopia accuses Eritrea, Sudan of backing Tigray rebels amid clashes
items.description: Ethiopia’s army chief accused Eritrea and Sudan on Sunday of backing armed groups fighting federal troops, as clashes with Tigrayan rebels intensified. items.title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
items.description: In rare access to Yemen's conflict zone the BBC travels to the front line with pro-government soldiers.

items.title: Five arrested near UK air base used by U.S. bombers in Iran war
items.description: U.K. police say five men were arrested on suspicion of preparation of a terrorist act after three vehicles were spotted near an air base the U.S. military has been using to launch attacks on Iran.

items.title: Russian and German FMs Meet for First Time Since Ukraine Invasion
items.description: Russia’s Foreign Ministry said that the ministers discussed bilateral relations and the war in Ukraine.

items.title: Russia expected to intensify hybrid war on Europe
items.description: Drone explosions, airspace violations, arson attacks: Poland, Romania, and Moldova are now regularly targeted in Russian attacks against Ukraine. More governments are calling these attacks deliberate acts of aggression.

items.title: Hoping to push the US away, Iran’s strategy is to go on the offensive
items.description: Nearly seven months after being attacked, an emboldened Iran is seeking to end the war on its terms. That means forcing U.S. bases out, lifting sanctions, and ending a U.S. naval blockade.

items.title: Ukrainian Soldiers Brave Russian Drones On Trek To Frontline Settlements
items.description: Ukrainian troops trek nearly 20 kilometers to reach Bilozerske in the embattled Donetsk region. In roughly one year, Russian drone and aerial attacks have laid waste to the city that used to house 15,000 inhabitants. Speaking with RFE/RL, one soldier said that "everything is bad" in the Dobropillia area.

items.title: Security Council LIVE: Rising tide of forced displacement
items.description: At a time when war, climate crises and man-made disasters continue to displace millions around the world, the UN High Commissioner for Refugees briefed the Security Council on Friday.
